content.text: There are ~29.3M free inodes and 30 batch directories. I’ll create **2,000,000** zero-byte files distributed evenly across them using a bash loop, leaving plenty of inode headroom. This may take a bit, so I’m running it as a background job with progress logging.

arguments.command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="file-generation-test"
TOTAL=2000000
LOG="$ROOT/logs/create-files-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).log"
mapfile -t DIRS < <(find "$ROOT/shards" -type d -name 'batch-*' | sort)
DIR_COUNT=${#DIRS[@]}
if [ "$DIR_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No batch directories found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
{
  echo "start=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  echo "total=$TOTAL"
  echo "directories=$DIR_COUNT"
} > "$LOG"

for ((i=1; i<=TOTAL; i++)); do
  d="${DIRS[$(( (i - 1) % DIR_COUNT ))]}"
  : > "$d/file-$(printf '%08d' "$i").empty"
  if (( i % 100000 == 0 )); then
    echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) created=$i" >> "$LOG"
  fi
done

echo "end=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$LOG"
echo "Created $TOTAL files. Log: $LOG"
